transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jessica. I need some information about my account. I'm trying to switch carriers and I need my account number and a porting PIN.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear you're leaving us. For security purposes, I'll need to verify your account first. Can I get your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's David Lewis.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, David. And the phone number associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see an account for David Lewis with that number. To fully access the account, could you please provide me with the four-digit security PIN you set up?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it should be 6395.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. That's correct. I have your account pulled up now. So, you're looking for your account number and a port-out PIN.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right. I thought I had the account number, but the new carrier said it was incorrect. I need to make sure I have the exact one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. That can be frustrating. Sometimes the number on the bill isn't the full account number needed for porting. Let me get the correct one for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And before we proceed, if you don't mind me asking, was there a specific reason for your decision to switch? We always value feedback to improve our services.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, no, the service has been fine. It's just a family thing. We're consolidating everyone onto a single family plan with another provider to save some money. It's just a better deal for all of us.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand that. It makes perfect sense to look for savings where you can. Thank you for sharing that with me.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, David. I can confirm your Cymbal Telecom account number. Do you have a pen and paper ready?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your account number is 9-8-0-0-1-0-2-8-5-5-2-1. Let me repeat that for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hold on, one second... okay, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. It's 9800, then 1028, and finally 5521.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. 9800-1028-5521. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Now, regarding the porting PIN. For your security, I can't see your existing PIN. Instead, I will generate a new, temporary Number Transfer PIN for you. This PIN is required by your new provider to authorize the transfer of your number from Cymbal Telecom.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's what I need. How does that work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's a straightforward process. First, as an additional security measure, I need to send a one-time verification code via SMS to the primary line on the account, which ends in 5874. Do you have that mobile phone with you right now?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'm talking on it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, of course. My apologies. In that case, I'll read the code to you from my system, and then I will have the system send it so you have a record. This is a bit of a different process when you're on the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wait, what? How does that work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize for the confusion. Let me re-explain. My system requires a two-factor authentication. Since you are on the line, I'll need to use an alternative method. Can you please confirm the email address on your account? It appears to be d-a-v-i-d dot l-e-w-i-s at telecom-personal dot com.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I am sending a verification code to that email address now. Can you please check your inbox and read the 6-digit code back to me?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, let me check. I'll have to put you on mute for a second while I open my email app.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem at all, take your time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I'm back. I have the email from Cymbal Telecom. The code is 8-1-9-3-4-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Let me enter that... 8-1-9-3-4-4. Excellent, the system has accepted the code. Thank you for your patience with that security step.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem. Security is good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I agree. Now, please give me just one moment to access the porting tool and generate your Number Transfer PIN. I'll need to place you on a brief hold, it should be no more than two minutes. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, that's fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, David. I have your Number Transfer PIN ready.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I'm ready.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your one-time Number Transfer PIN is 7-0-3-3-8-9. Again, that's 7-0-3-3-8-9.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: 7-0-3-3-8-9. Got it. And how long is this PIN valid for?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. The PIN is valid for seven calendar days starting today. If the port isn't completed within that time, you would just need to call us back to generate a new one.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, seven days. I should be able to get it done by then. So I just give the new company my account number and this new PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. They will also need the billing zip code associated with your Cymbal Telecom account. Can I confirm that for you as well?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that would be helpful, yes please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The billing zip code on file is 90210.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: 90210. Perfect. That's everything I should need then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It should be. Just so you are aware, once the port is successfully completed, your Cymbal Telecom account for this line will be automatically canceled. You don't need to call us back to cancel it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And what about the final bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will receive a final, pro-rated bill from us within about 20 days of the cancellation. It will be for the days of service used in your current billing cycle up until the port was completed. Any remaining balance will be charged to the card on file, or if there's a credit, it will be refunded.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. So I don't need to do anything else on my end with Cymbal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. The port-out process handles the cancellation. Do you have any other questions about the process or your account today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I think that's it. You've been very helpful, Jessica. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, David. I've also added a note to your account documenting that we provided the account number and generated a Number Transfer PIN today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can assist you with? Perhaps information on another line or any of our other services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Thanks again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. We're sorry to see you go, but we wish you the best with your new provider. Thank you for being a Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too, David. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wait, wait, actually, one more thing. Sorry.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course, I'm still here. What's on your mind?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: My wife also has a line with Cymbal. She's not on my account, it's a separate one. Does she need to do this same process?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, she will. If her account is separate and under her own name, she will need to call in herself to verify her identity and get her own unique account number and Number Transfer PIN.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's what I figured. I can't do it for her, right? Even if I have her information?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. For the security of her account, she must be the one to call and authorize the generation of the PIN. We can't share her account details with anyone, even a spouse, unless they are listed as an authorized user on the account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, right, privacy and all that. Makes sense. I'll let her know she needs to call. Is this department open for a few more hours?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, our Customer Care department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. She can call at any time that is convenient for her.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, 24/7. That's great. I'll tell her. Thank you for clarifying.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure. I'm glad you asked. It's always better to be sure.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Definitely. Okay, now I'm really done. That was the last thing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a problem at all, David. I'm here to help. Is there anything else, for real this time?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: (laughs) No, I promise. That's it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Once again, thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. We appreciate the time you've been with us. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, Jessica. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
